newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen up on hedge, short-covering demand.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen up on hedge, short-covering demand.

text.p: The key March Euroyen contract rose in mid-morning trade on Monday due to demand for hedging and short-covering, traders said.
"Major long-term and city banks received fixed interest rates in various maturities (in the swap market), inducing hedge purchases in the euroyen market," said a city bank trader.
The March rose to around 98.92 from Friday's 98.86 settlement. It was at 98.89 at 0115 GMT.
But profit-taking selling in the March set in at over 98.90, making its topside limited, traders said.
